evidence.no_public_sla: No published SLA for appeal response time
evidence.no_appeal_tracking: No public dashboard to track appeal status
evidence.transparency_report_scope: Reports show total appeals received/processed but not per-user
evidence.cloudflare_ban_appeal: Separate process for 'Invalid Request Limit' (Cloudflare) bans - often no appeal path
evidence.developer_vs_user: Bot developers and regular users share same opaque appeal path
evidence.no_oversight_board: Unlike Meta's Oversight Board, Discord has no independent appeals body

impact.description: Appeal denial as default: single support-ticket channel with no SLA, no tracking, no independent review. Cloudflare 'Invalid Request' bans (triggered by rate limit patterns) often have zero appeal path. Transparency reports aggregate but provide zero individual recourse visibility.

remediation.notes: Structural lack of appeal infrastructure; community relies on Twitter @discord for escalation
